result: Kotak card reviews use current product/FAQ pages and downloadable issuer KFS/MITC PDFs. Kotak Air+ Prime reviewed against the current card KFS, Prime T&Cs, MITC and product pages; voucher value conflict documented. Kotak Air+ reviewed against current product/FAQ pages, 12-Mar-2026 KFS, detailed T&Cs and consolidated MITC; annual-waiver conflict documented. Kotak Air reviewed against its current product/FAQ pages, current KFS and consolidated MITC; conflicting annual-fee waiver statements documented. Kotak League Platinum reviewed against current card/FAQ/fee/eligibility pages, KFSLP04062026 and consolidated MITC; unsupported launch date, Visa Platinum tier, lounge benefit and old fee/reward values corrected. PVR INOX Kotak reviewed against current PVR product page, KFSPIO12032026, current consolidated MITC/PVR terms, eligibility and a live PVR-app acquisition offer; unsupported airport-lounge/fuel-waiver/general-point claims removed. Kotak UPI RuPay reviewed against current card page, KFSKUR12032026 and consolidated MITC; corrected fee, rewards, exclusions, redemption and unsupported tier/launch/eligibility assertions. A utility fee threshold conflict between KFS (INR35,000) and consolidated MITC (INR50,000) remains recorded. Kotak Infinite reviewed against current card, fee, reward-redemption, eligibility and lounge pages, KFS, current MITC and the June 2025 change notice. The card is closed to new sourcing; age and legacy fee/reward page conflicts are recorded. Campaign PDF fetch for PVR offer returned HTTP 403; offer page is cited. Kotak White reviewed 2026-10-26; corrected milestone-only rewards, lounge spend gate, fees and eligibility, removed unsupported network/tier and launch date; source conflicts documented. Kotak Cashback+ Prime reviewed 2026-10-27 against current product page, card-specific Cashback+ Prime terms, and KFS KCB+PKFS04062026; corrected fees/APR/cash advance status, rewards cap/exclusions, fuel waiver and cleared unsupported network/launch claims. Kotak Cashback+ reviewed 2026-10-27 against the current product/claim pages, card-specific Cashback+ terms and KCBKFS04062026; corrected finance/cash-advance terms, rewards cap/exclusions, RuPay variant note and fuel waiver; the live claim page now states a 500-point redemption minimum from 16-Oct-2026. Kotak IndiGo XL reviewed 2026-10-27 against current product/fees/value/offers pages, card-specific terms, KFSIKXL12032026, consolidated MITC, MCC schedule, lounge list/terms and 2025 relaunch announcement; corrected fees, BluChip earn, lounge and milestone/welcome terms, removed unsupported network/eligibility/fuel waiver, and documented welcome-offer and lounge-variant conflicts. Kotak IndiGo base card reviewed 2026-10-27 using current product/fees pages, MITC, co-brand terms, rewards MCC schedule and relaunch announcement; corrected fee schedule, 3-card-BluChip flight component, milestones, welcome/renewal, network and lounge/fuel-waiver claims. Co-brand terms and MCC schedule referenced from adjacent XL archive after CDN 403; migrated-card fee and meal-welcome discrepancies documented. Kotak Solitaire reviewed 2026-10-27 against current product/rewards/fees pages, KFSKS04062026, retail MITC, detailed terms, reward MCC schedule and lounge documents; corrected fees/program waiver, travel earn cap, transfer ratios/redemption, guest-lounge quota and fuel waiver. Detailed T&C browser-readable but direct file download returned HTTP 403; add-on-card count conflict documented. Kotak Zen Signature reviewed against current card, fee, reward, milestone, redemption and eligibility pages, KFSZS12032026 and consolidated MITC; corrected fee/APR/cash advance, redemption values, lounge quotas, fuel waiver, milestones and published eligibility; unsupported launch date/network tier cleared.
